title: Shadows of Uniform Hypergraphs under a Minimum Degree Condition
summary: Given a set $X$ and an integer $t$, let $\mathcal{F}$ be a family of $k$-subsets of $X$. The Kruskal--Katona theorem implies that if $|\mathcal{F}|\geq \binom{t}{k}$, then $|\partial_\ell\mathcal{F}|\geq\binom{t}{\ell}$. The minimum degree version of this problem asks: if $δ(\mathcal{F})\geq \binom{t}{k-1}$, how small can $|\partial_\ell\mathcal{F}|$ be? We call a hypergraph \textit{extremal} if it achieves the minimum value of $|\partial_\ell \mathcal{F}|$ subject to the degree condition $δ(\mathcal{F}) \geq \binom{t}{k-1}$. Füredi and Zhao [SIAM J.
